+		commandInput: textinput.New(),

+		m.showLineNumbers = opts[0].showLineNumbers

+		teatest.WithInitialTermSize(80, 40),
+	)

+		tm.Output(),
+		func(b []byte) bool {
+			out = b
+			return true
+		},
+		teatest.WithCheckInterval(100),
+		teatest.WithDuration(1000),
+	)
+	return out
+}
